registration.task: wave 49 — quilt-jepa: a tiny JEPA world model living inside an anisotropic cell mesh, with stone receipts (the 'latent grid' architecture: cells are the latent space)
registration.seal_discipline: this file sealed BEFORE any run: seal.self_sha256_masked = sha256 of these exact bytes with the seal.self_sha256_masked value replaced by 64 zeros (fixed-position mask); seal.mtime_local forced back via utimes after last write so recorded mtime binds sealed bytes and predates every receipt in receipts/
registration.seed_provenance: training seed comes from the moth API comet-qrng-v1 certified stream via tools/certified-seed.mjs (fail-closed to LABELED local fallback if the API is unreachable — fallback is receipted in the run header and the claim scoring for P4 is unaffected because determinism is about the SAME seed twice)
registration.law: loss = mean((predicted_latent - target_latent)^2) in latent space ONLY (no pixel reconstruction — the JEPA law); target encoder updated by EMA tau=0.999 (stop-gradient); context encoder + predictor trained by clipped SGD; world = 16x16 cell grid, synthetic wave+ball field; mesh = Perona-Malik anisotropic diffusion, lambda=0.2 <= 0.25 stability bound

claims.text: Learning: mean latent-prediction loss over the last 10 training steps is < 25% of the mean loss over the first 10 steps of the run (same seed).
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff receipts show ratio < 0.25; else FAIL with the ratio

claims.text: EMA stationarity: L2 drift of the target encoder over the final 200 steps is < 1% of its final L2 norm (tau=0.999 fixed point behavior).
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff drift_norm / final_norm < 0.01; else FAIL with the ratio

claims.text: Anomaly surprise: mean mesh-surprise energy at the 3 registered anomaly ticks exceeds 3x the mean surprise over the 30 non-anomaly sampled ticks in the held-out evaluation segment.
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff anomaly_mean / baseline_mean > 3.0; else FAIL with the ratio

claims.text: Determinism crown: two full runs with the same certified seed produce byte-identical receipt chains (sha256 of the receipt file equal).
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff run1/run2 receipt file sha256 equal; else FAIL with both hashes

claims.text: Diffusion conservation law: under diffusion-only mesh steps (lambda=0.2), total mesh energy is conserved within 1e-6 relative and energy variance is strictly non-increasing across 100 consecutive steps (Perona-Malik with conductance <= 1 is a variance contraction, NOT an energy sink — registering the conservation, not a decay).
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff max relative total drift <= 1e-6 AND variance sequence non-increasing; else FAIL with the first violating step

claims.text: Zero self-repair (E-Q10 port to a learned substrate): corrupting 10% of context-encoder weights at tick T raises loss, and with NO further gradient steps the loss at T+50 does not fall below the post-corruption level (allowing 1e-9 tolerance for numeric noise) — the world model does not silently heal.
claims.verdict_rule: PASS iff loss(T+50, frozen corrupted weights) >= loss(T, corrupted) - 1e-9 AND loss(T, corrupted) > loss(T-1) * 1.5; else FAIL
